brief: Match either orientation of a pair, stopping at the first-word sentinel.
decl: std::uint32_t record_pair_match(std::span<const std::byte> pairs, std::uint32_t first, std::uint32_t second);
notes: Original instructions establish controller ordering; callback bodies remain external implementations.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete symmetric pair scan; a first-word 0xffffffff sentinel ends scanning before the second word is accessed.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Readable pair rows through a sentinel or earlier match; unterminated/truncated host spans are rejected, not original-fault equivalents.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 216 original/native cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang; connected lifecycle traces also match. See docs/recovery/record-transitions.md.
